epistemic_policy.primary_project_sources: Establish repository-declared architecture, implementation, terminology, and status.
epistemic_policy.external_sources: Support the writing, argumentation, scientific-communication, accessibility, and engineering method. They do not prove repository behaviour.
epistemic_policy.editorial_synthesis: Must be labelled and must not be represented as a verbatim runtime API.
epistemic_policy.certification: No certification, flawless-output, universal-safety, or general-superiority claim is made.

claims.proposition: Model output remains advisory and cannot create its own mutation or release authority.
An unchanged exhausted attempt is blocked until materially relevant state changes or a terminal stop is justified.
Exact snapshot, target, candidate, command, evidence, and risk identity limit approval drift.
Governance imposes real process cost and should be treated as a risk-sensitive engineering trade-off.
Formal Writing requires an explicit thesis, evidence, reasoning, synthesis, counterargument treatment, calibrated certainty, and citation integrity.
The compact admissibility equations on the website are an editorial abstraction of named repository constraints, not a verbatim runtime API.
